## [trial] Isang pagbabago, may may-ari at sukatan

Si Elena, 38, ay naghahanda ng trial upang bawasan ang maling printout sa BHS. Kailangan ang kasunduan ng team at sukatan ng tama at napapanahong materyal.

Mungkahi ni Elena: i-check ang approved handout bago bawat print run. Siya ang maghahanda ng checklist, ang midwife ang kukumpirma sa bersyon, at susuriin nila makalipas ang dalawang linggo ang bilang ng maling printout at kung may naantalang session. Itala ang bilang ng sessions upang makumpara ang magkatulad na trabaho. Ibahagi ang resulta sa kasama at baguhin ang proseso kung may epekto sa kalidad. Ang pagbabago ay kailangang napagkasunduan, hindi basta bagong utos sa lahat.

## [compare] Subukan ang simpleng paghahambing

Kathang-isip na datos: dati, 20 sa 100 printed pages ang inuulit dahil maling bersyon; matapos ang checklist, 5 sa 100. Bumaba ang reprints ng 15 bawat 100 pahina, mula 20% tungong 5%. Bago sabihing matagumpay, itanong kung pareho ang uri ng sessions at kung nakatanggap pa rin ng tamang materyal ang mga kalahok. Hindi kailangan ng patient name para masukat ang print waste.

## [communicate] Ibahagi ang mungkahi sa kasama

Sabihin ang napansing aksaya nang walang paninisi: “May dalawang bersyon sa drawer kaya may nauulit na print.” Ilahad ang mungkahi, sino ang may trabaho at kailan rerepasuhin. Tanungin ang kasama kung may hadlang na hindi nakita, tulad ng walang internet para kunin ang bagong file. Maaaring kailangan ang controlled paper master. Ang resourcefulness ay paghahanap ng ligtas at aprubadong alternatibo, hindi paglabag sa policy.

## [workload] Kapag iba-iba ang workload

Isang linggo ay 5 ang teaching sessions; sa susunod ay 10. Maaaring dumami ang nagamit na papel kahit mas mahusay ang proseso. Ihambing ang wastong materyal at reprints kada session o bawat 100 pahina, kasama ang anumang reklamo o delay. Huwag mag-claim ng savings mula sa raw total lamang. Ihiwalay ang pagbabago sa workload mula sa pagbabago sa paraan.

## [handover] Panatilihin kahit magpalit ng tao

Kapag wala si Elena, dapat magamit pa rin ng kapalit ang teaching kit at checklist. Ilagay ang maikling routine sa lugar ng trabaho, ituro sa bagong kasama at tukuyin kung kanino iuulat ang stock gap. Sa review, alisin ang hakbang na walang silbi at panatilihin ang proteksyong kailangan. Ang sustainable na sistema ay hindi umaasa sa alaala ng iisang masipag na tao.

## [practice] Subukan, saka ulitin

Punan ang trial card: problema, pagbabago, owner, baseline, sukatan ng kalidad, review date. Gamitin ang 20/100 at 5/100 para sa patas na paghahambing. Magpares: isa ang kasamahang walang internet; ipaliwanag ang controlled paper master at handover. Kung mag-isa, isulat ang magiging routine ng kapalit. Sa team meeting, ipasuri ang trial bago simulan at magtakda ng review.

## [check] Piliin ang susunod na hakbang

Piliin ang sagot at ipaliwanag kung bakit bago tingnan ang feedback. Pagkatapos, ihambing sa sarili mong ginawa sa pagsasanay.

## [trial] One change, an owner and a measure

Elena, 38, is preparing a trial to reduce incorrect printouts at the BHS. The team needs an agreement and a measure of correct, timely materials.

Elena proposes checking the approved handout before each print run. She prepares the checklist, the midwife confirms the version, and after two weeks they review incorrect printouts and any delayed sessions. Record session counts to compare similar workloads. Share results and revise the process if quality suffers. Agree on the change rather than issuing a new rule to everyone without discussion.

## [compare] Try a simple comparison

Fictional data: previously, 20 of 100 printed pages had to be reprinted because the version was wrong; after the checklist, 5 of 100. Reprints decreased by 15 per 100 pages, from 20% to 5%. Before declaring success, check whether session types were comparable and participants still received correct materials. Patient names are unnecessary for measuring print waste.

## [communicate] Share the proposal with colleagues

Describe waste without blame: “There are two versions in the drawer, which causes reprinting.” Present the proposal, responsibilities and review date. Ask colleagues about overlooked barriers, such as lack of internet for the updated file. A controlled paper master may be needed. Resourcefulness finds safe, approved alternatives rather than bypassing policy.

## [workload] When workloads differ

One week has five teaching sessions and the next has ten. Total paper use can rise even when the process improves. Compare correct materials and reprints per session or per 100 pages, alongside complaints or delays. Do not claim savings from a raw total alone. Distinguish workload changes from process changes.

## [handover] Keep the routine when people change

When Elena is absent, a colleague should still be able to use the teaching kit and checklist. Keep a short routine at the work area, orient new colleagues and identify who receives stock-gap reports. During review, remove unhelpful steps and preserve necessary safeguards. A sustainable system does not depend on one diligent person’s memory.

## [practice] Try it, then repeat

Fill a trial card: problem, change, owner, baseline, quality measure, review date. Use 20/100 and 5/100 for a fair comparison. In pairs, one colleague has no internet; explain the controlled paper master and handover. Alone, write the replacement colleague’s routine. Ask the team to review the trial before starting and set a review date.

## [check] Choose the next step

Choose an answer and explain why before viewing the feedback. Then compare it with your own practice attempt.

## [purpose] Layunin

Magmungkahi ng maliit na trial na may owner at review date, at ihambing ang resource use sa magkatulad na workload kasama ang kalidad ng serbisyo.

## [time-materials] Oras at kagamitan

60 minuto para sa pagsasanay na pinamumunuan ng facilitator. Bahagi ito ng 3 oras ng subchapter; ang maikling Read ay hindi kapalit ng buong pagsasanay. Gamitin ang sitwasyon at checklist sa ibaba, papel at panulat. Walang tunay na personal na rekord sa pagsasanay.

## [prepare] Ihanda

Ihanda ang dalawang halimbawang 100-page tally at blank trial card. Tiyakin kung sino ang may authority sa approved version at trial.

## [opening] Pambungad

Kalahati ang nabawas sa papel dahil kalahati rin ang nakanselang sessions. Ano ang masasabi?

## [steps] Mga hakbang

Basahin ang sitwasyon. Ipakita ang isang halimbawa gamit ang checklist sa Obserbahan. Ipagawa ang pagsasanay sa pares o tatluhan. Magbigay ng tiyak na feedback at ipaulit ang bahaging kailangan pang ayusin. Ibigay ang check bago ipakita ang paliwanag.

## [expected-answers] Inaasahang sagot

Sa comparison check, bumaba ang reprint ng 15 bawat 100 pahina; tiyaking maihahambing ang workload at tama pa rin ang materyal. Hindi patunay ang rate na ito na 75% ang nabawas sa gastos.

Sa communication check, tugunan ang kawalan ng internet sa pamamagitan ng kontroladong papel na master, pagtitiyak sa bersyon at paghingi ng puna ng kasama. Huwag gumamit ng hindi aprubadong lumang kopya.

Ang unang sagot ay isinasaalang-alang ang workload at kalidad. Ang kabuuang bill o papel lamang ay maaaring bumaba dahil nawala ang serbisyo, hindi dahil bumuti ang proseso.

## [misconception] Karaniwang pagkakamali

Ipinapahayag na tagumpay ang mas mababang total kahit bumaba o nakansela ang serbisyo. Ang mas mababang konsumo ay tagumpay lamang kung naibibigay pa rin ang tama at ligtas na serbisyo.

## [practice] Gawaing pagsasanay

Punan ang trial card: problema, pagbabago, owner, baseline, sukatan ng kalidad, review date. Gamitin ang 20/100 at 5/100 para sa patas na paghahambing. Magpares: isa ang kasamahang walang internet; ipaliwanag ang controlled paper master at handover. Kung mag-isa, isulat ang magiging routine ng kapalit. Sa team meeting, ipasuri ang trial bago simulan at magtakda ng review.

## [answer-key] Susi sa sagot

Comparison check: 1. Bawas na 15 reprint bawat 100 pahina; suriin ang workload at tamang materyal.

Communication check: 2. Maghanda ng kontroladong papel na master, tiyakin ang bersyon at hingin ang puna.

1. Hindi pa patunay ng improvement; ihambing ang gamit bawat session at naibigay na serbisyo.

Ang unang sagot ay isinasaalang-alang ang workload at kalidad. Ang kabuuang bill o papel lamang ay maaaring bumaba dahil nawala ang serbisyo, hindi dahil bumuti ang proseso.

## [observe] Obserbahan

May owner, baseline, quality measure at review date ang trial; tama ang 20% tungong 5% na paghahambing; isinasaalang-alang ang workload at handover.

Kaya na: May owner, baseline, quality measure at review date ang trial; tama ang 20% tungong 5% na paghahambing; isinasaalang-alang ang workload at handover. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.

Kailangan pang magsanay: Kumpleto ang plano ngunit raw total lang ang comparison; ipagamit ang bawat session o bawat 100 pahina.

Hindi pa: Ipinapahayag na tagumpay ang mas mababang total kahit bumaba o nakansela ang serbisyo.

Markahan bawat pamantayan ng nagawa / may tulong / hindi pa. Magtala ng eksaktong sinabi o ginawa. Ang feedback ng kapareha ay pagsasanay lamang; ang staff observation ay para lamang sa aktuwal na naobserbahan. Huwag markahang lahat ay kaya na dahil may isang nagpakita.

## [support] Tulong

Kumpleto ang plano ngunit raw total lang ang comparison; ipagamit ang bawat session o bawat 100 pahina. Maaaring magsalita, magsulat o magpatulong magbasa. Gumamit ng wikang komportable ang kalahok. Panatilihin ang parehong pamantayan.

## [purpose] Purpose

Propose a small trial with an owner and review date, and compare resource use at comparable workloads alongside service quality.

## [time-materials] Time and materials

60 minutes of facilitated practice within the subchapter's 3 hours; short Read completion does not replace that training. Use the scenario and checklist below, paper and a pen. No real personal records in practice.

## [prepare] Prepare

Prepare the two fictional 100-page tallies and a blank trial card. Confirm authority for the approved version and trial.

## [opening] Opening

Paper use halved because half the sessions were canceled. What can be concluded?

## [steps] Steps

Read the situation. Model one attempt against the Observe checklist. Run the practice in pairs or triads. Give specific feedback and repeat the part needing improvement. Ask the check before revealing the explanation.

## [expected-answers] Expected answers

For the comparison check, reprints fell by 15 per 100 pages; confirm that workload and correct materials remained comparable. This rate does not prove a 75% reduction in cost.

For the communication check, address the no-internet barrier with a controlled paper master, version verification and colleague feedback. Do not substitute an unapproved old copy.

The first response accounts for workload and quality. Total bills or paper can fall because service was lost, not because the process improved.

## [misconception] Common misconception

Declares lower totals a success despite reduced or canceled services. Lower consumption is a success only when correct, safe service is still delivered.

## [practice] Practice activity

Fill a trial card: problem, change, owner, baseline, quality measure, review date. Use 20/100 and 5/100 for a fair comparison. In pairs, one colleague has no internet; explain the controlled paper master and handover. Alone, write the replacement colleague’s routine. Ask the team to review the trial before starting and set a review date.

## [answer-key] Answer key

Comparison check: 1. Fifteen fewer reprints per 100 pages; check comparable workload and correct materials.

Communication check: 2. Prepare a controlled paper master, verify its version and ask for feedback.

1. This does not yet show improvement; compare use per session and services delivered.

The first response accounts for workload and quality. Total bills or paper can fall because service was lost, not because the process improved.

## [observe] Observe

Specifies owner, baseline, quality measure and review date; correctly compares 20% with 5%; accounts for workload and handover.

Ready: Specifies owner, baseline, quality measure and review date; correctly compares 20% with 5%; accounts for workload and handover. Completes this without prompting.

Needs practice: Completes the plan but compares raw totals only; prompt for per-session or per-100-page measures.

Not yet: Declares lower totals a success despite reduced or canceled services.

Mark each criterion done / prompted / not yet and record the exact words or action. Peer feedback is practice; staff observations cover only performances actually observed. One demonstration does not establish that everyone is ready.

## [support] Support

Completes the plan but compares raw totals only; prompt for per-session or per-100-page measures. Allow spoken or written responses and reading assistance. Use the participant’s preferred language while keeping the same criteria.
